pages._note: Project/WBS list as a declarative type:index page (pipelinq-views-to-declarative-r2): budgetAmount→EUR currency, billable→boolean indicator, status + ledgerSyncStatus→badges. 'Nieuw project' navigates to ProjectDetail id:'new'; row open navigates to ProjectDetail (stays custom — parallel cross-schema phases/tasks/activities + WBS tree). DROPPED the per-cell overdue end-date red highlight: it was a conditional cell text colour (endDate red+bold when past due and not finalised), and no declarative primitive expresses conditional cell colouring (cell `format` is value-shape only; `rowClass` is a Function prop with no manifest binding). endDate renders as a plain date column.
pages.title: Projecten
Project
pages._note: Renders through CnDetailPage/CnDetailCard already, but a type:detail page describes ONE object and this hosts three nested editable child entities — phase, task and activity — each with its own CnFormDialog and save handler (onPhaseSaved / onTaskSaved / onActivitySaved) writing back into the WBS tree. It also resolves the client name across registers and probes ledger webhook status. Decomposing it would need a declarative primitive for child-entity create/edit within a parent detail, which the lib does not have.

pages.title: Tijdregistraties
pages._note: A type:index page lists stored fields; this page's whole purpose is DERIVED values it must compute client-side — minutesToHours, formatDuration, resolveBillable and a totals rollup that sums billable vs non-billable time across the project's activities. None of those exist as properties on the activity schema, so there is nothing for a declarative column to bind to.
